summary: 12 of 15 confirmed starters, with Barcola on the bench for his Liverpool debut, Doku out until 13 September, and Garner also on the bench behind Hackney - a correction on Garner, who did not actually start midweek as earlier reported. Marmoush is likely rather than nailed given genuine competition from Solanke at Tottenham. The dashboard's My squad tab should treat Doku, Garner and Barcola as non-starters this gameweek despite their model availability figures, and Munoz and Bijol as safer starts than their model numbers suggest.
